parameters.help_en: The ID of the model card to update. This ID is returned by the model creation operation and is in a format that starts with mc-
parameters.help_zh: 要更新的模型卡片 ID。该 ID 由创建模型卡片接口返回，格式以 mc- 开头
parameters.name: model_card_id

fields.help_en: The model invocation path. Maximum length: 2048 characters
fields.help_zh: 模型调用路径，长度不超过 2048 个字符
fields.name: path

fields.help_en: The protocol type of the path. Maximum length: 64 characters
fields.help_zh: 路径对应的协议类型，长度不超过 64 个字符
fields.name: type

parameters.help_en: The list of invocation paths supported by the model. Each item must include both path and type. The list is overwritten as a whole during updates
parameters.help_zh: 模型支持的调用路径列表。每一项必须同时包含 path 和 type，更新时按整个列表覆盖
parameters.name: available_paths

fields.help_en: The cache hit token cost in Credits per million tokens. The value must be greater than or equal to 0. Default value: 0
fields.help_zh: 缓存命中 Token 费用，单位为 Credits/百万 Token。取值大于或等于 0，不传时默认为 0
fields.name: cache_cost

fields.help_en: The input token cost in Credits per million tokens. The value must be greater than or equal to 0. Default value: 0
fields.help_zh: 输入 Token 费用，单位为 Credits/百万 Token。取值大于或等于 0，不传时默认为 0
fields.name: input_cost

fields.help_en: The output token cost in Credits per million tokens. The value must be greater than or equal to 0. Default value: 0
fields.help_zh: 输出 Token 费用，单位为 Credits/百万 Token。取值大于或等于 0，不传时默认为 0
fields.name: output_cost

fields.help_en: The billing type. Only fixed is supported. Default value: fixed
fields.help_zh: 计费类型。当前仅支持 fixed；不传时默认为 fixed
fields.name: type

parameters.help_en: The credit billing information of the model. Only the fixed type is supported. The unit is Credits per million tokens. If not specified, all cost values default to 0
parameters.help_zh: 模型的 Credit 计费信息。当前仅支持 fixed 类型，费用单位为 Credits/百万 Token；不传时各项费用默认为 0
parameters.name: credit

parameters.help_en: The model capability switches. Keys must be model capability names supported by the API gateway. Values are Boolean
parameters.help_zh: 模型能力开关。键必须是 API 网关支持的模型能力名称，值为布尔值
parameters.name: features

fields.help_en: The maximum number of input tokens supported by the model. The value must be greater than or equal to 0
fields.help_zh: 模型支持的最大输入 Token 数。取值大于或等于 0
fields.name: max_input_tokens

fields.help_en: The maximum number of output tokens supported by the model. The value must be greater than or equal to 0
fields.help_zh: 模型支持的最大输出 Token 数。取值大于或等于 0
fields.name: max_output_tokens

fields.help_en: The maximum total number of context tokens supported by the model. The value must be greater than or equal to 0
fields.help_zh: 模型支持的上下文最大 Token 总数。取值大于或等于 0
fields.name: max_tokens

fields.help_en: The list of input modalities supported by the model. The list contains up to 16 items, and each item must not be empty
fields.help_zh: 模型支持的输入模态列表，最多包含 16 项，每一项均不能为空
fields.name: supported_input_modalities

fields.help_en: The list of output modalities supported by the model. The list contains up to 16 items, and each item must not be empty
fields.help_zh: 模型支持的输出模态列表，最多包含 16 项，每一项均不能为空
fields.name: supported_output_modalities

parameters.help_en: The token limits and input/output modality information of the model
parameters.help_zh: 模型的 Token 上限和输入、输出模态信息
parameters.name: meta

parameters.help_en: The model name. The name must be unique within the same AI gateway instance and model provider. Maximum length: 256 characters
parameters.help_zh: 模型名称。同一 AI 网关实例、同一模型供应商下必须唯一，长度不超过 256 个字符
parameters.name: model_name

parameters.help_en: The model provider identifier. The value must reference an existing model provider in the target AI gateway instance. Maximum length: 128 characters
parameters.help_zh: 模型供应商标识。必须引用目标 AI 网关实例中已存在的模型供应商，长度不超过 128 个字符
parameters.name: model_provider

code.description_en: The response status code. Ok is returned for successful requests
code.description_zh: 响应状态码。请求成功时返回 Ok

availablePaths.description_en: The list of invocation paths supported by the model. Each item includes both path and type
availablePaths.description_zh: 模型支持的调用路径列表。每一项同时包含 path 和 type

items.description_en: A single model invocation path configuration
items.description_zh: 单个模型调用路径配置

path.description_en: The model invocation path. Maximum length: 2048 characters
path.description_zh: 模型调用路径，长度不超过 2048 个字符

type.description_en: The protocol type of the path. Maximum length: 64 characters
type.description_zh: 路径对应的协议类型，长度不超过 64 个字符

credit.description_en: The credit billing information of the model. The unit is Credits per million tokens
credit.description_zh: 模型的 Credit 计费信息。费用单位为 Credits/百万 Token

cacheCost.description_en: The cache hit token cost in Credits per million tokens
cacheCost.description_zh: 缓存命中 Token 费用，单位为 Credits/百万 Token

inputCost.description_en: The input token cost in Credits per million tokens
inputCost.description_zh: 输入 Token 费用，单位为 Credits/百万 Token

outputCost.description_en: The output token cost in Credits per million tokens
outputCost.description_zh: 输出 Token 费用，单位为 Credits/百万 Token

type.description_en: The billing type. Only fixed is supported
type.description_zh: 计费类型。当前仅支持 fixed

features.description_en: The model capability switches. Keys are model capability names supported by the API gateway. Values are Boolean
features.description_zh: 模型能力开关。键为 API 网关支持的模型能力名称，值为布尔值

gatewayId.description_en: The ID of the AI gateway instance to which the model card belongs
gatewayId.description_zh: 模型卡片所属的 AI 网关实例 ID

meta.description_en: The token limits and input/output modality information of the model
meta.description_zh: 模型的 Token 上限和输入、输出模态信息

maxInputTokens.description_en: The maximum number of input tokens supported by the model. The value must be greater than or equal to 0
maxInputTokens.description_zh: 模型支持的最大输入 Token 数。取值大于或等于 0

maxOutputTokens.description_en: The maximum number of output tokens supported by the model. The value must be greater than or equal to 0
maxOutputTokens.description_zh: 模型支持的最大输出 Token 数。取值大于或等于 0

maxTokens.description_en: The maximum total number of context tokens supported by the model. The value must be greater than or equal to 0
maxTokens.description_zh: 模型支持的上下文最大 Token 总数。取值大于或等于 0

supportedInputModalities.description_en: The list of input modalities supported by the model. The list contains up to 16 items, and each item must not be empty
supportedInputModalities.description_zh: 模型支持的输入模态列表，最多包含 16 项，每一项均不能为空

items.description_en: A single modality name in the input modality list
items.description_zh: 输入模态列表中的单个模态名称

supportedOutputModalities.description_en: The list of output modalities supported by the model. The list contains up to 16 items, and each item must not be empty
supportedOutputModalities.description_zh: 模型支持的输出模态列表，最多包含 16 项，每一项均不能为空

items.description_en: A single modality name in the output modality list
items.description_zh: 输出模态列表中的单个模态名称

modelCardId.description_en: The model card ID. The ID is generated by the system and starts with mc-
modelCardId.description_zh: 模型卡片 ID。由系统生成，格式以 mc- 开头

source.description_en: The source of the model card. For instance-level model cards, user is returned
source.description_zh: 模型卡片来源。当前实例级模型卡片返回 user

updateTime.description_en: The last update time of the model card in the format of yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss
updateTime.description_zh: 模型卡片的最近更新时间，格式为 yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss

message.description_en: The response message. success is returned for successful requests
message.description_zh: 响应消息。请求成功时返回 success

requestId.description_en: The request ID generated by the system for troubleshooting purposes
requestId.description_zh: 请求 ID，由系统生成，用于定位本次调用

v1_body_parameters.help_en: The request body for updating an AI model card. PUT uses full replacement semantics. If credit or meta is not specified, it is overwritten with the default object. The availablePaths field is overwritten as a whole list
v1_body_parameters.help_zh: 更新 AI 模型卡片的请求体。PUT 采用完整更新语义，未传的 credit 和 meta 会按默认对象覆盖，availablePaths 按整个列表覆盖
v1_body_parameters.name: body
